description: This file defines the Version class in the ZipStream\Option namespace, representing different ZIP version constants as enumeration values.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: An enumeration class representing ZIP version options (STORE, DEFLATE, ZIP64).

methods.name: STORE
methods.description: Returns the Version instance representing the STORE method (value 0x000A).

methods.name: DEFLATE
methods.description: Returns the Version instance representing the DEFLATE method (value 0x0014).

methods.name: ZIP64
methods.description: Returns the Version instance representing the ZIP64 method (value 0x002D).
